remarks: ATTENTION INVESTORS AND FLIPPERS! A perfect opportunity awaits in Corinthia Park. This half duplex bi-level is the perfect project for a handyman. The upper level features the kitchen, living room, dining area, a full bathroom, and 2 bedrooms, the lower level features a living  room with a wood burning fireplace, 2 more bedrooms, mechanical room and a 2nd bathroom. The fully fenced backyard with a concrete parking pad completes this home. FANTASTIC LOCATION! Backing onto Kinsmen Park, the playground is just a stone's throw away from the backyard. Walking distance to Leduc Composite High School and Kinsmen Community Center, and close to many amenities. Come see for yourself before it's gone! (id:67522)
